name: NGC 4157, SN 2003J field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4157, a nearly edge-on spiral galaxy and host of SN 2003J, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2003jhost-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy tipped nearly edge-on, its small nucleus peering out from a thick layer of dust. It hosted SN 2003J, a normal Type II supernova.

claims.text: SN 2003J is a normal Type II supernova
NGC 4157 is a spiral galaxy seen nearly edge-on (spindle)
Only a small nucleus peers out of the thick dust layer of NGC 4157
